name: City builder
description: Lay out a whole town on a big map: paint roads, water and fields, put buildings down (your saved buildings, or footprints you drag out), add walls, fences and trees, and see it all in a light, quick 3D view. Read a 2D battle map picture to get a best guess of the town from above, then change what it got wrong. Each building opens in the building editor and comes out as its laser-cut pieces.
